entities.name: Mohamed Said Ramadan Al-Bouti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad Said Ramadan Al-Bouti was a renowned Syrian Sunni Muslim scholar and author. He was served as professor and vice dean at the Damascus University, also serving as the imam of the Umayyad Mosque.
